text: Building a Rust-first evidence runtime around Recall, Gloss, ClaimLedger, and the RecursiveIntell library workspace.
Recall focuses on daemon authority, runtime truth, typed receipts, doctor reports, and Codex repair packets.
Gloss is the local-first document workspace for grounded chat, notebook-local storage, and source-linked answers.
ClaimLedger compiles source-spanned claims, evidence bundles, support judgments, contradictions, review queues, and testimony exports for Gloss.
The Rust Libraries workspace separates canonical crates, satellite utilities, and research-linked quantization work by explicit support boundaries.
Palisade keeps Linux firewall mutation behind a privileged daemon with validation, snapshots, and rollback.
VisionForge connects Ollama and ComfyUI through local prompt engineering, queueing, gallery, and generation-receipt workflows.
Sortarr is a Rust daemon and React UI for self-hosted media organization with review gates and planned rollback receipts.
projmind builds a local project-memory daemon using Rust, git state, tree-sitter extraction, and Ollama analysis.
Core technical focus: Rust, Tauri, Tokio, SQLite, IPC boundaries, receipts, source spans, and local-first runtimes.
The stack treats claim support, contradiction, quarantine, and testimony as explicit artifacts rather than hidden prose.
Quantization work such as turbo-quant and fib-quant stays gated behind local receipt-backed benchmarks and non-claims.
